translationRepairs: He released palace women to return home, thereby restoring households that had lacked someone to rely on.
He released palace women to return to their homes, exempting them from further obligations.

In 出宮人歸其家，復無所與, 復無所與 is the standard Han formula remitting tax/corvée so the released palace women have nothing to contribute; the before invents 'restoring households that had lacked someone to rely on,' while the after correctly renders the exemption.
Liang Chu two kings both passed away.
The two kings of Liang and Chu both passed away.

梁楚二王 means the two kings of the states of Liang and Chu; the before's word-for-word 'Liang Chu two kings' is broken English that obscures that structure, and the after restores the correct reading without changing sense.
